summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Can you trust Meta’s Muse or OpenAI’s Dots to run your life?
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
